email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — war-focused clan, 5,000 trophy minimum
email.body:
POAP KINGS is a Clash Royale clan built around Clan Wars, real recognition, and a culture that most clans never bother to create.

We have 45 members, three sitting at 14,000 trophies, and over 3,500 donations logged this week. Our top war contributors this season are putting up 3,000+ fame over two races. We track all of it.

What makes us different: we issue POAPs for seasons and milestones, run a Free Pass Royale program for top war performers, and use Elixir — our own AI clan operator — to track stats, recognize effort, and build clan memory over time.

We want players who show up for war, donate to clanmates, and want to be part of something intentional. Real life comes first, but when you're in, we notice.

Minimum 5,000 trophies. Come see what we're building at https://poapkings.com

reddit.title: POAP KINGS #J2RGCRVG | War-focused clan with real culture | [5000] trophies required | 45/50 members
reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS — #J2RGCRVG**

**Quick stats:**
- 45 members, 5,000 trophy minimum
- Three members at 14,000 trophies
- 3,500+ donations this week
- Top war contributors: 3,000+ fame through two races this season
- Clan war trophies: 660 and climbing

**Who we are:**

POAP KINGS is a war-focused clan that also cares about building something with staying power. We track stats, recognize effort, and create actual clan memory — not just a Discord server with a trophy requirement.

We run a **Free Pass Royale program** for top war performers each season. We issue **POAPs** (collectible proof-of-attendance tokens) for seasons and milestones. We have **Elixir**, our own AI clan operator, tracking war performance and calling out real contributions.

Our top players — OllieTurtle, Vijay, and Aaqib Javed — are all at 14,000 trophies. Our donation leaders are consistent week over week, not one-week spikes.

**What we're looking for:**
- Players who participate in Clan Wars when they can
- Consistent donators who support clanmates
- People who want to be part of a clan with identity, not just a leaderboard slot

Real life always comes first. But if you're going to play, we'd rather you play with people who notice.

Find us at https://poapkings.com or search the tag in-game.
